sectionEdges.note: Butt joins. No margin, no border, no negative offset, no overlap on either side; the black is .sd-216's own background-color and it is the only painted background in the section.

animations.note: __cloneSnap.animations('main > .sd-216') at 1440 after full-page scroll -> {count:0}. No @keyframes anywhere on the page.

appear.trigger: IntersectionObserver, threshold 0 (fires as soon as the element's top crosses the viewport bottom)
appear.runtimeMechanics: class 'appear' is REMOVED on reveal; the attributes data-appear and data-inited-appear stay (both empty); an inline style is written: 'transition: 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1, 1, 1) 0.4s, --g-angle, ... --g-position-11;'. 'appear-active' is never used in this section. Reveal is once-only.

hoverCta.target: a.sd-229 (the only interactive element in the section)
hoverCta.transition: inherited base 'all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.4, 0, 1)' on every one of the five nodes (transitionDuration 0.3s, transitionDelay 0s)

hoverNegative.method: page.mouse.move over (300,300) Studio.Stock card, (1000,300) Unsplash image, (200,60) heading band at scrollY 7300, 700 ms settle each; snapshot of opacity/translate/filter/transform/scale/borderRadius/backgroundColor/color on .sd-226 .sd-235 .sd-224 .sd-234 .sd-228 .sd-227 .sd-218
hoverNegative.conclusion: REFUTED: there is no hover on either image, on the card, or on the heading. The 8 pseudo-class rules that match the section are all .sd-229:hover*.

clickAndToggle.note: the single <a> opens https://stock.studio.design/ in a new tab; no in-page click behaviour exists

backgroundMachinery.conclusion: REFUTED: neither image uses the 'image' / 'image__bg-container' custom-property machinery. Both are plain with aspect-ratio 1380/1000 and object-fit fill; no element in the section has a background-image and no ::before/::after has content.

themeVsSdRule.finding: the theme rules are written as '.text.theme-XXXX' (specificity 0,2,0) and beat the '.sd-NNN' rules (0,1,0) on the same property.
themeVsSdRule.case: .sd-222 declares font-size:16px base and font-size:12px inside @media (max-width: 768px); .text.theme-a3931427 declares 1rem base and 0.875rem at <=768px and at <=480px. Measured computed font-size: 16px @1440, 14px @768, 14px @390 -> the theme rule wins at <=768. Enumerated via document.styleSheets at 768.
themeVsSdRule.cloneImpact: app/studio-base.css already carries '.sd-root .text.theme-*' (lines 916, 946, 948, 1007, 1026, 1044, 1045) at (0,3,0) vs the slice's '.sd-root .sd-222' at (0,2,0) - the same winner. Do NOT 'fix' the 12px rule; it is dead on the origin too.

images.variantRule: the Studio runtime rewrites src from the inline data: URI placeholder to a size variant: _middle.webp at 1440 (rendered 690px) and at 768 (rendered 720px), _small.webp at 390 (rendered 342px). data-sd-img-src always points at the full-size .png.
